verdict.rationale: RudderStack supports event-driven logic through custom JavaScript/Python Transformations that filter, enrich, and reshape events in flight before delivery. Tracking Plans also catch and fix or filter non-compliant events at the source, Alerts notify on critical data issues, and PII can be blocked, masked, or encrypted before it goes downstream. These are rules applied to events, but there is no evidence of a general rule or trigger engine that fires arbitrary actions (e.g., workflows or API calls) when conditions are met. Missing for 10: a declarative rule or trigger builder, documented condition-to-action automation beyond in-flight transformation and validation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
